title: Average Derivative Estimation and Honest Inference under a Vanishing Treatment Density
banked_reason: Mathematically sound matching ADE frontier, but D0.5 graded it subfield below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.8 < 7.4), with no bounded same-topic repair; Chen–Gao positioning locator remains unresolved.
gap_reasons: The contribution here is the class-specific calculation and its direct random-design implementation.
Unknown-density inference and adaptive point-estimation risk remain deferred, limiting the result’s reach for causal practice.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived matching same-class minimax MSE and honest interval-length rates for the ordinary ADE, including the uniform critical logarithm and the exact honest smoothness-adaptation price; the math panel passed with no findings. The field-tier claim collapsed at novelty review because the contribution is an exact-class realization of general Donoho/Cai–Low modulus principles, while unknown-density inference and adaptive point-risk require materially new constructions. A future re-raise should reuse the PIT class map and multiscale lower-bound artifacts, correct the Chen–Gao locators to Example 5/equation (12)/Assumption 4, and add a genuinely broader construction rather than presentation-only changes.
tldr: What accuracy and honest confidence length are possible for the ordinary causal average derivative when a known treatment density vanishes with \(0<\kappa\leq1\)? General Gaussian optimal-recovery theory reduces such questions to moduli even for an unbounded score. This proposal calculates the modulus of the exact probability-integral-transformed ADE Hölder class, then seeks matching same-class iid random-design MSE and interval bounds, the critical \(\log n/n\) transition, and the attained price of honest smoothness adaptation.
gap: General Gaussian optimal-recovery and honest-interval theorems apply at the level of moduli, even for an ambient unbounded score, but the inspected sources do not evaluate the exact probability-integral-transformed ADE Hölder class or give its uniform iid random-design frontier.
fill: Calculate the exact class-specific and between-class ADE moduli uniformly through the critical exponent; establish matching same-class iid upper and lower bounds and the attained honest smoothness-adaptation price.
